snippet:
Place: National Gallery (Neue Nationalgalerie)
   Address: Matthäikirchplatz, 10785 Berlin, Germany
   Activity: Explore modern and contemporary art collections, including works by renowned artists from the 20th century.

Place: Curry 36
   Address: Mehringdamm 36, 10961 Berlin, Germany
   Activity: Enjoy authentic Berlin currywurst, considered one of the best and most popular stands in the city.

Place: KaDeWe (Kaufhaus des Westens)
   Address: Tauentzienstraße 21-24, 10789 Berlin, Germany
   Activity: Shop for women's clothing, including plus sizes (size 52) in a variety of fashion brands in one of Europe's largest and most famous department stores.

Place: Kurfürstendamm (Ku'damm)
   Address: -
   Activity: Continue shopping or strolling along this famous commercial street with many boutiques and fashion stores offering a wide range of women’s clothing sizes.
